evidence_rules: 1955–1984 is an explicit low-confidence pre-association baseline derived from the American Samoa Government's statement that ASTA celebrated 40 years in 2025.
The 1985 foundation year is derived from that official 40-year anniversary and is not treated as a direct participation count.
2019 Pacific Games participation and 2025 Pacific Nations Cup hosting establish active regional competition structure but results are not rating targets.
Current OTF membership and AO Pathway participation are gated to 2026.
Small-territory institutional activity is not treated as world-leading national scale.
